map.MBTI（迈尔斯-布里格斯类型指标）通过四组心理倾向——外倾 E / 内倾 I、: MBTI (Myers-Briggs Type Indicator) combines four pairs of psychological preferences — Extraversion E / Introversion I, Sensing S / Intuition N, Thinking T / Feeling F, Judging J / Perceiving P — into 16 personality types. The test helps you understand your energy source, information-processing style, decision style, and life rhythm, and is widely used for self-awareness and team communication.

map.MBTI 在职业发展与团队沟通中应用广泛，但学术心理学对其信效度有持续争议，重测: MBTI is widely used in career development and team communication, but academic psychology continues to debate its validity and reliability, and about half of people land in a different type on retesting. Treat it as a reference framework for self-awareness rather than a precise measurement.
map.为什么两次测出来类型不一样？: Why Did I Get a Different Type the Second Time?
map.四组维度都是倾向而非绝对二分，当某项倾向接近中间时，不同状态或题意理解会造成翻面: All four dimensions are preferences rather than hard binary splits; when a preference is near the middle, changes in state or how a question is read can flip the result. Answer based on your real preferences rather than your ideal self, and the result is more stable.
map.16 种类型之间有优劣之分吗？: Is One of the 16 Types Better Than the Others?
map.没有优劣。每种类型只是偏好组合不同，对应不同的能量来源、信息处理方式与行动风格，: There is no better or worse. Each type is just a different combination of preferences, with its own energy source, information-processing style, and action style; what matters is understanding the differences and complementing one another.
